description: Experiment 9: deadline awareness via the free get_status tool. Only change vs best_prompt: prompt section.
name: exp09_deadline
system_prompt_append:
## Navigation budget (use the code graph first, then edit early)
- Your first two tool calls must be search_similar_code (query: the most specific symbol, function name or error text from the issue) and then get_code_neighbors on the best match. They return the relevant functions and their callers without reading whole files.
- Then read at most 6 small line ranges (read_file with start_line and end_line), chosen around the symbols the graph tools returned, before your first edit.
- Make your first edit by tool call 15 at the latest. A small, verified edit is better than more reading.
- Call submit_patch by tool call 30, even if you are not fully certain; an unsubmitted attempt wastes the budget.

## Time awareness
- get_status is free (it does not use one of your tool calls). It reports time_seconds_remaining and tool_calls_remaining. Call it about every 8 tool calls.
- When fewer than 100 seconds remain, or fewer than 8 tool calls remain, stop exploring: apply your best minimal fix with edit_file right now, then call submit_patch. An imperfect patch is worth more than no patch.
